description: UCI row 1 (age 22, HIGH vulnerability, basic knowledge, RT 7) — sector equity etf: hard fails ['R5'] -> UNSUITABLE
client_narrative: Kwabena Mensah is 22 years old. Their gross annual income is approximately 33,000 euros (around 2,750 euros per month). They hold 56,000 euros in liquid savings and wish to invest 7,600 euros with a 4-year investment horizon. In terms of financial background, the client has basic investment experience, limited to savings accounts, fixed-term deposits, and simple fixed-income products. Their investment approach is growth-oriented and risk-tolerant — they rate their risk appetite at 7 out of 10. They have stated they cannot afford to lose the full 7,600 euros invested. They have been assessed as financially vulnerable.
product_narrative: The product is a UCITS exchange-traded fund providing concentrated exposure to European technology and digitisation sector companies. The fund publishes a KID, trades intraday on regulated exchanges, uses no leverage, and holds no embedded derivatives. It is classified NON-COMPLEX under MiFID II Article 25(4)(a). Sector concentration produces higher volatility than diversified equity funds; basic financial knowledge is required. The recommended minimum holding period is five years.
